Welcome to the Divoom API

    
##### command description

-Command to set the current play status.


| Head  |Len   | Cmd   | Data |Checksum   |Tail   |
| :------------: | :------------: | :------------: | :------------: | :------------: | :------------: |
|0x01   |xx (2 bytes) |0xa   |xx  | xx |0x02   |

Data: Pause: 0, Play: 1
